10-17.event: Bobby Fischer's 'Game of the Century' vs Donald Byrne (age 13, queen sacrifice, mate in 41)

10-18.event: Tennis for Two shown at Brookhaven visitors' day (early entertainment video game)

10-19.event: Santos-Dumont wins the Deutsch Prize: airship No. 6 round the Eiffel Tower in 29 min 30 s

10-20.event: Sydney Opera House opened by Queen Elizabeth II (budget A$7m -> A$102m, Utzon never saw it finished)

10-21.event: Guggenheim Museum (Frank Lloyd Wright) opens in New York; 16 years of work, Wright died 6 months before opening

10-22.event: André-Jacques Garnerin: first parachute descent from a balloon, Parc Monceau, Paris (~900 m, basket under canopy)

10-23.event: Apple iPod unveiled by Steve Jobs (25th anniversary): 5 GB, 1,000 songs, $399

10-24.event: Annie Edson Taylor, 63-year-old teacher, first to survive Niagara Falls in a barrel (on her birthday; test cat survived)

10-25.event: Windows XP launched in New York by Bill Gates (25th anniversary); Bliss wallpaper story (O'Rear 1996, flew the film himself)

10-26.event: The Football Association founded in London (26 Oct 1863), Morley's laws, rugby split, first game Barnes-Richmond 0-0

10-27.event: New York City Subway opened (27 Oct 1904, 2:35 pm), 28 stations, 9.1 mi, nickel fare, >100,000 riders, Mayor McClellan drove; City Hall station closed 1945
